test-env-cli: refactor the CLI interface
The previous subcommand-based interface made it difficult to perform multiple operations in a single invocation. Users needed to run the script multiple times to sync different data types.
Replaced argparse subcommands with a cleaner resource-oriented design: - 'list' and 'show' commands for environment information - 'sync' command that accepts comma-separated data types (datamodel,tags,cdb) - 'push-code' command for deploying code - Unified time range options (--from/--to) that work across all data types - Added support for duration syntax (e.g., '2h', '3d', '10m') - Made tag copying non-interactive by default - Fixed CentaurTime import issues by using cdt module functions
